## Research interests

::: {.research-grid .research-grid-four}
::: {.research-card}
### Probability Theory

Probabilistic structures, asymptotic behavior, and mathematical methods for random systems.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Stochastic Processes

Continuous-time stochastic models and the evolution of random systems over time.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Interacting Particle Systems

Large systems of interacting random particles and their collective behavior.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Metastability

Rare transitions, multiple time scales, and effective dynamics in stochastic systems.
:::
:::

## About this site

This website will grow with my graduate study. It is intended as a long-term home for mathematical notes, seminar materials, teaching resources, and future research work.
